local done=false local report=GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(),6)..'.results.txt' function OnPluginInstall() local f=assert(io.open(report,'w')) f:write('START indentation regression\n');f:close() end local function RunIndentTest() if done then return end if GetAlphaOption('site') ~= '127.0.0.1' or IsConnected() then return end done=true local pueblo=GetOption('port')==18767 if pueblo then SetOption('use_mxp',0) Simulate('This world is Pueblo 1.10 enhanced.\r\n') else SetOption('use_mxp',2) end DeleteOutput() local url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Balerion300/mushclient/codex/inline-static-images/tests/fixture-scene.png' Simulate(pueblo and ('') or ('\027[1z')) Simulate('

\tFIRST_PARAGRAPH

\r\n\tSECOND_PARAGRAPH\r\n') Simulate('

\t\tDOUBLE_INDENT

\r\n

TEXT\tINTERIOR_TAB

\r\n') local f=assert(io.open(report,'w')) local expected={FIRST_PARAGRAPH=8,SECOND_PARAGRAPH=8,DOUBLE_INDENT=16,INTERIOR_TAB=0} local seen={} for line=1,GetLinesInBufferCount() do local text=GetLineInfo(line,1) for marker,spaces in pairs(expected) do if text:find(marker,1,true) then local ok if marker=='INTERIOR_TAB' then ok=text==(pueblo and 'TEXT INTERIOR_TAB' or 'TEXT INTERIOR_TAB') else ok=text==string.rep(' ',spaces)..marker end seen[marker]=true f:write(ok and 'PASS ' or 'FAIL ',marker,' ',string.format('%q',text),'\n') end end end for marker in pairs(expected) do if not seen[marker] then f:write('FAIL missing ',marker,'\n') end end f:close() end function OnPluginTick() if done then return end local ok,err=pcall(RunIndentTest) if not ok then done=true local f=assert(io.open(report,'a')) f:write('ERROR ',tostring(err),'\n');f:close() end end
